fact: Act No. 14 of 2026, assented 12 August 2026, amends the Statistics Act (adds the Ministry of Finance to section 2A(1), repeals section 10(2), adds item 35 'Government and public sector debt' to the First Schedule), treating it as a law in force.

The Budget Annex 2026-2027 refers to the governance, quality assurance, oversight and confidentiality safeguards 'provided under the Statistics Act' and says the Act will be amended on public sector debt statistics and on prior approval of the Statistics Board; the document is dated by its published date.

The IMF Data ROSC says the Statistics Act gives Statistics Mauritius its legal mandate (Articles 3, 10 and 22) and that the authorities report most recommended amendments already made through the Finance Act 2025.

Statistics Mauritius says it operates under the Statistics Act 2000, which sets its mandate to collect, compile and disseminate statistics and to coordinate producers; the document gives March 2021 as its date.

The document is the text of the Statistics Act (Act 38 of 2000), in its consolidated version as amended in 2011, which commenced on 2 April 2001 and makes Statistics Mauritius the central statistical authority.
